scenario: `error:` continuation fires on CallError per LCCO.8.1/8.2. Simulate: trigger → pump (call fires) → assert CallError with matching corr → pump → error clause fires. Pin: action_log appears in error clause.
rules_ds:
service svc.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min as "corr2"
        error:
            log info "call failed"
